raw: {"analysis":"Both responses address the core requirements well, but XBN's shadow mode deployment is a stronger operational strategy—it lets the team verify deduplication and ingestion in production before enabling bi-directional notifications, which directly de-risks the 'no pause in traffic' constraint. SWN provides more detailed CI budget management and a clearer incremental rollout (5% traffic ramp), but its approach of going straight to bi-directional sync after replay testing is riskier given staging can't test real inbound replies. XBN also more explicitly addresses the 'open cases remain editable immediately' requirement in Lane B's work description, while SWN buries this in the rollback section.","verdict":"XBN"}
